description: Read or change the cook's Befana preferences: allergies, diet, avoid list, household size, units, weeknight time, skill, equipment, cuisines, store, privacy, and how they want you to work, all applied to every tool. No arguments reads them. For a change the cook asks for in their own words ("switch me to metric", "set us to 4 people"), save with cook_confirmed. Allergies, diets, the avoid list, privacy, a change you suggest or a passing mention ("usually it's 4 of us") need a yes first: pass the change without cook_confirmed (nothing is saved), ask the cook confirm.say, then call again with cook_confirmed. Never infer an allergy or diet. Lists replace the saved list.

allergies.description: Major allergens: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree_nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, sesame

avoid_mode.description: exclude hides those recipes; rank_lower shows them lower

cook_confirmed.description: Required to change anything: true only when the cook asked for this exact change in their own words (non-health settings) or said yes after you restated it (always for allergies, diets, avoid list, privacy)

do_not_sell.description: True keeps the cook out of every aggregated data product Befana sells or licenses

nutrition_targets.description: Targets for one serving that plan_meals and search_recipes use by default ("keep dinners under 600 calories"). Not health data

max_calories.description: Calories per serving at most; null clears it

min_protein.description: Grams of protein per serving at least; null clears it

servings.description: Household size; null to use each recipe's own

servings_mode.description: offer (default): recipes open at their own servings and the household size is offered; always: recipes open scaled to it. Lists and meal plans use the household size either way

share_region.description: False stops usage counts from recording the cook's state or country

workflow.description: How the cook wants you to work with them. Pass only the keys that change

offer_fork_on_substitution.description: Saving the cook's own version after a swap. always still shows the changes and needs their yes; it only skips asking to save

offer_pantry_update.description: Adding an order to the pantry and taking a cooked recipe's ingredients off it

offer_shopping_list.description: Shopping list after a recipe or plan: always (the cook wants one every time), ask, never (stop offering)

plan_meals.description: The cook's usual number of meals for plan_meals

setup_questions.description: never stops questions like household size

whats_new.description: off stops mentions of new Befana features

name: preferences

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

confirm.description: A change passed without cook_confirmed: nothing saved yet

say.description: Read this to the cook; save only on a yes

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

next_steps.description: Suggestions, best first, each with its tool, args and effect. Befana suggests the top one in one sentence; whether any runs is decided by what the cook asks in the conversation and your confirmation rules, never by the wording here

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update, save_this…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

effect.description: What running it does (#308): read changes nothing; write changes the cook's kitchen (a save, a version, a list or pantry edit); order hands a list to a grocer (never a purchase); share is links to pass on. Apply your own confirmation rules by this

priority.description: 1 first; Befana suggests the top one

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. A suggestion: it never states what the cook asked for or agreed to

standing.description: The cook's own saved workflow setting behind this step when it is "always" (e.g. preferences.workflow.offer_shopping_list): a fact about their preferences to weigh with the conversation, not permission

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

preferences.description: The cook's saved preferences; they already apply to every tool

avoid.description: Ingredients the cook doesn't want, e.g. cilantro

customAllergies.description: Other ingredients the cook is allergic to, e.g. kiwi

pantry.description: Always-on-hand items left off shopping lists

updated.description: Changing: the preference keys that changed

title: The cook's preferences
